claim_boundary: These observations describe sampled frames and caption alignment. They do not establish turn meaning, speaker intent, audience response, learner outcome or communication effectiveness.

method.rule: one sampled frame near the midpoint of each selected raw-media interval

items.frame_observation: Speaker is visible at a microphone with an audience behind her; the displayed caption includes the full reflective question, ‘I wonder what I could do?’
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports wording and public setting, not whether the question invited a response or changed audience behavior.

items.frame_observation: Speaker is visible in a White House press-room setting, but the sampled frame is dominated by an edit/title treatment and does not display the short ‘how about that’ caption.
items.alignment_limit: The source edit prevents treating this frame as exact visual alignment for the question-like phrase.

items.frame_observation: Two people are visible in a seated interview setting with event branding; the caption visibly displays ‘Why don't we start right at the beginning?’
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports a question and interview setting, not turn ownership, prosody or the answer that followed.

items.frame_observation: Speaker is visible at a formal podium against an institutional marble backdrop; the caption displays ‘Externally, this means reformed multilateralism.’
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports wording and setting, not whether the reformulation is complete, accurate or understood.

items.frame_observation: The speaker appears in a dark interview/story setting; the sampled frame displays nearby personal-story text rather than the exact short translation ‘Bijli means electricity.’
items.alignment_limit: The raw source is available, but this sample does not isolate the exact target caption; resampling adjacent frames is required.

items.frame_observation: Speaker is visible at the White House podium with the U.S. flag and White House backdrop; the sampled frame does not display the exact ‘we need to save for schools’ wording.
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports formal setting only; it does not support exact visual alignment or audience response.

items.frame_observation: Speaker is centered at a formal podium against a marble institutional backdrop; the caption visibly reads ‘We need to create a global architecture.’
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports the proposal wording, not feasibility, ownership, consent or listener uptake.

items.frame_observation: Speaker remains at the same formal podium; the caption visibly reads ‘let us strive to return to the course of seeking peace.’
items.alignment_limit: The frame supports a collective appeal, not a measurable action plan or audience commitment.

next_actions: Have an independent reviewer inspect all eight intervals.
Resample the definition translation and edit/title intervals at both boundaries.
Add a manual counterexample review for each candidate packet.
Keep all observations provisional until source/event and learner gates are complete.
